description: ADR 30.10.26p D3: the developer-facing log line the core (and, for rows with no embed_version, the web widget) writes for the first update_available a handle hears. Target lingara_embed::update, level warn. The wording never compares versions: latest can be lower than the declared build once the newest version is yanked. A message is appended verbatim after ": ", cut to 280 Unicode scalar values.
